description_en: Queries the DDoS mitigation information of an RDS Custom for SQL Server instance and the details of the associated Anti-DDoS Origin instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS Custom for SQL Server实例的DDos防护信息及所属原生防护实例的详情
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-rc-instance-ip-address --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ddos-region-id cn-beijing --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRCInstanceIpAddress

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Custom instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the assets that are assigned public IP addresses to query. Set the value to ecs
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的公网IP资产的实例类型，固定值ecs
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The DDoS mitigation status of the assets that are assigned public IP addresses to query. Valid values:

defense: Cleaning. Assets that are assigned public IP addresses for which Anti-DDoS Origin scrubs traffic are queried.
blackhole: Black Hole Activated. Assets that are assigned public IP addresses that are in the blackhole filtering status are queried
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产的DDoS防护状态，取值：

defense：清洗中，即查询正在进行流量清洗的公网IP资产。
blackhole：黑洞中，即查询处于黑洞状态的公网IP资产
parameters.name: ddos_status

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Custom instance to which the assets that are assigned public IP addresses belong
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的公网IP资产所属的Custom实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the assets that are assigned public IP addresses to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的公网IP资产的IP地址
parameters.name: instance_ip

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1, which indicates that the first page is returned
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: Settings for paged query. The number of instances to return on each page for paging
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时每一页的实例数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to ecs
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the assets that are assigned public IP addresses to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的公网IP资产所在地域ID
parameters.name: ddos_region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the Custom instance to which the assets that are assigned public IP addresses belong
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的公网IP资产所属的Custom实例名称
parameters.name: instance_name

RCInstanceList.description_en: The details of instances to which the assets that are assigned public IP addresses belong
RCInstanceList.description_zh: 公网IP资产所属实例的详情列表

InstanceStatus.description_en:
The DDoS mitigation status of the instance. Valid values:

normal: Normal.
abnormal: Under attack
InstanceStatus.description_zh:
实例的DDoS防护状态。返回值：

normal：正常
abnormal：被攻击中

InstanceType.description_en: The type of the assets that are assigned public IP addresses. The value is fixed as ecs
InstanceType.description_zh: 公网IP资产的类型，固定值ecs

IpAddressConfig.description_en: The details of the assets that are assigned public IP addresses

items.description_en: The details of the assets that are assigned public IP addresses

BlackholeThreshold.description_en: The basic DDoS Mitigation Threshold of the assets that are assigned public IP addresses. Unit: Mbit/s
BlackholeThreshold.description_zh: 公网IP资产的DDoS基础防护阈值。单位：Mbps

DefenseBpsThreshold.description_en: The traffic scrubbing threshold of the assets that are assigned public IP addresses. Unit: Mbit/s
DefenseBpsThreshold.description_zh: 公网IP资产的流量清洗阈值。单位：Mbps

DefensePpsThreshold.description_en: The message rate scrubbing threshold of the assets that are assigned public IP addresses. Unit: pps
DefensePpsThreshold.description_zh: 公网IP资产的报文数量清洗阈值。单位：pps

ElasticThreshold.description_en: The DDoS burstable Mitigation Threshold of the assets that are assigned public IP addresses. Unit: Mbit/s
ElasticThreshold.description_zh: 公网IP资产的DDoS弹性防护阈值。单位：Mbps

InstanceIp.description_en: The IP address of the assets that are assigned public IP addresses

IpStatus.description_en:
The DDoS mitigation status of the assets that are assigned public IP addresses. Valid values:

mitigating: Cleaning.
blackholed: Black Hole Activated.
normal: Normal
IpStatus.description_zh:
公网IP资产的DDoS防护状态。返回值：

mitigating：清洗中
blackholed：黑洞中
normal：正常

IpVersion.description_en:
The IP protocol version of the instance. Valid values:

v4
v6
IpVersion.description_zh:
实例的IP协议版本。返回值：

v4
v6

IsBgppack.description_en:
Indicates whether the assets that are assigned public IP addresses is attached to Anti-DDoS Origin. Valid values:

true: Attached.
false: Not attached
IsBgppack.description_zh:
公网IP资产是否已绑定DDoS原生防护。返回值：

true：是
false：否

IsFullProtection.description_en:
Indicates whether best-effort protection is enabled for the assets that are assigned public IP addresses in Anti-DDoS Origin. Valid values:

0: Best-effort protection is not enabled.
1: Best-effort protection is enabled
IsFullProtection.description_zh:
公网IP资产是否在原生防护中全力防护。返回值：

0：非全力防护
1：全力防护

RegionId.description_en: The region encoding of the assets that are assigned public IP addresses
RegionId.description_zh: 公网IP资产所属的地域编码

Total.description_en: The total number of assets that are assigned public IP addresses returned
Total.description_zh: 查询到的公网IP资产的总数量
